newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Canadian shot dead by sailor in south Philippines.
newsitem.headline: Canadian shot dead by sailor in south Philippines.

text.p: A Canadian was killed when a drunken Philippine sailor raked his beach house with gunfire, police in the southern Philippines said on Monday.

The victim was having drinks with a friend in the house on the island resort of Santa Cruz on Sunday evening when the suspect, who served in the Philippine Navy, opened fire, police chief Edwin Soledad in nearby Zamboanga told reporters.

A passport found by police on the victim bore the name Laurence George Woolcox, from Vancouver. Tourism department records showed he was a retired military pilot and had been in the Zamboanga area since 1994 doing business.
The Canadian Embassy in Manila said it had received a copy of the police report on the incident naming the victim as Woolcox and the embassy was trying the confirm the victim's identity.
The suspected killer surrendered to police after the shooting and was charged with murder.
Initial investigation indicated the victim and the sailor had quarrelled before the shooting, Soledad said. Police recovered 24 empty shells of an assault rifle from the scene.
The Canadian's drinking companion was unhurt in the shooting.
